newsitem.title: FRANCE: De Niro, Almodovar, Techine given Legion of Honour.
newsitem.headline: De Niro, Almodovar, Techine given Legion of Honour.

text.p: U.S. actor Robert de Niro, Spanish director Pedro Almodovar and French filmmaker Andre Techine were given the Legion of Honour, one of France's highest awards, in a tribute staged on Friday at the Cannes festival.

French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, retracing the careers of the three men in a ceremony on the beach of the palatial Carlton Hotel, quoted Martin Scorsese as once saying of de Niro, the star of "Mean Streets", "Taxi Driver" and "Raging Bull": "I don't know how he does it."
De Charette said of Almodovar: "You have said that 'if directors made the films they wanted to make, they would be much more original'. You yourself have never violated that rule."
Techine was hailed as a determined director who shunned schools and trends -- "your work, deeply personal, bears the mark of your authenticity".
